_about: Stage A's day, sleep and night (scripts/camp/camp_day.gd). The clock runs from start_hour to end_hour over real_seconds_per_day of real time, then waits there until everyone in the camp is ready for bed. Bed opens at evening_hour. The calendar's minute is game minutes since start_hour. While the camp has no guest PC and the menu is open, the clock waits too. The host's clock is the true one; it tells a guest PC send_hz times a second. light blends the daylight mood into dusk between the two hours (data/lighting.json). A stay is one guest at one pitch: a guest comes at arrive_hour when a pitch is free (max_stays at once), stays nights nights and pays its pitch's lodging price (coins) each night, then heads home the next morning. Guests walk in from entry ([x, z] metres) at walk_speed_mps and stand at stand_offset from the pitch centre. looks are guest camper models, used in turn; names are in data/text.json guest.names.
